blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Sisi Rondina-Rosales treated her fellow Cebuanos with a thrilling five-set comeback in her PVL return after a six-month stint for Alas Pilipinas beach volleyball. Rondina-Rosales joined hands with Eya Laure to lift Choco Much from two sets down and eke out a come-from-behind 22-25, 18-25, 25-17, 25-20, 15-8 win over the revamped Capital1 in the league’s 10th season opener of the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Saturday at SM Seaside Cebu Arena here. She made an immediate impact just more than a week removed from her Asian Games beach volleyball quarterfinals appearance. Sisi Rondina-Rosales talks about her homecoming […]...
